sa: एवं प्रज्ञानतृप्तस्य निर्भयस्य निराशिषः। न मृत्युरतिगो भावः स मृत्युमधिगच्छति॥
en: The state of death cannot with selfknowledge, who is shorn of fear, desire and expectancy. On the other hand, such a person conquers death.

sa: तेन सिंहप्रणादेन नामविश्रावणेन च। ज्याशब्देन च भीमेन त्रासयामास वानरान्।६॥
en: And with his leonine roars and the proclamation of his name, and the tremendous twang of his bow-string, he struck terror into the monkeys.

sa: तस्य काश्चनचित्राङ्गं रथं साश्वं ससारथिम्। जघान गदया श्रीमानङ्गदो वेगवान्हरिः॥
en: Thereat, that graceful monkey, Angada, gifted with vehemence, with his mace crushed his car decked in gold, together with the steeds and the charioteer.

sa: इत्युक्तो धर्मराजस्तु सहसा वाक्यमप्रियम्॥ कथमित्यब्रवीद् वाचा शोकार्तः सज्जमानया। युधिष्ठिरो गुडाकेशं भ्राता भ्रातरमच्युतम्॥ उवाच दीनो राजा च धनंजयमिदं वचः। प्रमाणमस्मि यदि ते मत्तः शृणु वचोऽनघ॥
en: I shall go into exile to the forest, for we made this rule.” Suddenly hearing those most painful words uttered (by Arjuna), Yudhishthira, was afflicted with grief and sad in agitated voice, “Why?" Then Yudhishthira thus spoke in grief to his vowobserving brother Gudakesha (curly haired) Dhananjaya (Arjuna), “O sinless one, if I am an authority worthy of regard, listen to what I say-an

sa: अपां पतिः कथं ह्यस्मिन्नभिषिक्तः पुरा सुरैः। तन्मे ब्रूहि महाप्राज्ञ कुशलो ह्यसि सत्तम।॥
en: How was the king of the waters installed by the celestials in that Tirtha formerly. O best of men, tell me all that, for you are highly wise and are skilled narrator.

sa: अयोध्यापि पुरी रम्या शून्या वर्षगणान्बहून्। ऋषभं प्राप्य राजानं निवासमुपयास्यति॥
en: The picturesque city of Ayodhyā remained devoid of men for many long years but was again peopled under the regime of the King Rsabha.

sa: ततो दशशताक्षेण साधु साध्विति भाषितम्। अहो विज्ञानमित्येवं मनसा पूजितस्ततः॥
en: Well-done, well-done! said the thousandeyed god. Then the latter lauded him in his mind, saying 0, how wonderful is the knowledge which he possesses.

sa: स्वैराचाराश्च पुरुषा योषितश्च विशाम्पते। अन्योन्यं न सहिष्यन्ति युगान्ते पर्युपस्थिते॥
en: O king, men and women will become perfectly free in their conduct. When this age will come, they will not tolerate one another's acts.

sa: प्रस्थितं मानुयान्तीमे ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। न चास्मि पोषणे शक्तो बहुदुःखसमन्वितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: The Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas, are following me who am departing. Afflicted with many calamities, I am unable to support them.

sa: स तमन्तःपुरे घोरमार्तशब्दं महीपतिः :। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः श्रुत्वा चासीत् सुदुःखितः॥
en: Hearing the loud tumult of lamentation in the inner apartment, the lord of earth burning in grief for his son was stricken with sorrow.

sa: तस्मात् त्वं सर्वयत्नेन यतस्वातिथिभोजने। पादोदकं पादघृतं दीपमन्नं प्रतिश्रयम्॥ प्रयच्छन्ति तु ये राजन् नोपसर्पन्ति ते यमम्।
en: Therefore with all care entertain guests. O king, those that give to his guests water to wash his feet, butter to rub over his tired legs, light in darkness and food and shelter, do not (at all) go before Yama.

sa: स चेमं संकुलं लोकं प्रसादमुपनेष्यति। उत्थितो ब्राह्मणो दीप्तः क्षयान्तकृदुदारधीः॥ संक्षेपको हि सर्वस्य युगस्य परिवर्तकः। स सर्वत्र गतान् क्षुद्रान् ब्राह्मणैः परिवारितः। उत्सादयिष्यति तदा सर्वम्लेच्छगणान् द्विजः॥
en: He will restore order and peace in this world overcrowded with creatures and contradictory in its laws. That effulgent and greatly intelligent Brahmana will destroy all things. He will be the destroyer of all and he will be the makes of a new Yuga, That twice-bom one surrounded by the Brahmanas, will exterminate all the low and despicable Mlechchhas wherever they will be found.

sa: मा विषादं गमस्तस्मान्नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते। विनष्टे त्वयि चास्माकं पक्षो हीयेत कौरव॥
en: Do not give way to despondency. O descendant of Kuru, this conduct does not suit you. If you die, our party will become weak.

sa: कर्णेन सार्धं राजेन्द्र सौबलेन च देविना। दुःशासनादयश्चास्य भ्रातरः सर्व एव ते॥ भूरिश्रवाः सोमदत्तो महाराजश्च बाह्निकः। स्थैर्नानाविधाकारैर्हयैर्गजधरैस्तथा॥ प्रयान्तं नृपसिंहं तमनुजग्मुः कुरूद्वहाः। कालेनाल्पेन राजेन्द्र स्वपुरं विविशुस्तदा॥
en: Blazing in great splendour he went in front (of the army) accompanied by Karna, Subala's son, the gambler (Shakuni), Dushashana and all his other brothers, Bhurishrava, Somadatta, the great king Bahlika followed that foremost of kings with various sorts of chariots, horses and excellent elephants. O foremost of kings, within a short time all those perpetuators of the Kuru race entered their own city.

sa: बभौ निशामुखे व्योम खद्योतैरिव संवृतम्। स मार्गेणगणैौणिर्दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वतः॥
en: The firmament looked (as beautiful) as if adorned with glow-worms during the night. Covering all the directions with innumerable arrows, the son of Drona.

sa: स तस्याः संप्रमत्तायाश्चोदितः कालधर्मणा। विषोपलिप्तान्दशनाम्भृशमङ्गे न्यपातयत्॥
en: The snake, to fulfil the will of Fate, bit the heedless girl with its venomous fangs.

sa: तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मा मृत्युमिवाहवे। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्यः समपद्यत॥
en: His enemies could not approach him then, like creatures unable to approach the Death. Then the son of Hridika came there, on another car.

sa: ततः कृतस्वस्त्ययनाधौम्येन सह पाण्डवाः। द्विजसबै परिवृताः प्रययुः काम्यकं वनम्॥
en: Thereupon the Pandavas, blessed by the auspicious rites and, accompained by Dhaumya and surrounded by the Brahmanas, set out for the forest of Kamyaka.

sa: ततः समाहिता त्वा दूती बाहुकमब्रवीत्। दमयन्त्यपि कल्याणी प्रासादस्था [पैक्षत॥
en: Brihadashva said: Thereupon the female messenger carefully approached Bahuka and addressed him, while blessed Damayanti looked from her palace what would come to pass.

sa: राजन् संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्। केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: O king, I am feeling more and more pleasure as much as I am remembering the holy and wonderful words between Srikrishna and Arjuna.

sa: इच्छन्नहं विकुर्यां हि रूपाणि बहुधाऽऽत्मनः। विभीषणानि यानीक्ष्य पलायेथास्त्वमेव मे॥
en: If I wish, even now I can assume various dreadful forms, seeing any one of which you would immediately fly away from my presence.

sa: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां येऽनुपश्यन्ति केचन। पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते त्रिदिवेश्वरैः॥
en: O Rāma, one, who beholds you, even for a moment, becomes pure and worthy of repairing to heaven. Even the leading deities worship him.

sa: बाहुक उवाच इहैव पुत्रौ निक्षिप्य नलस्य शुभकर्मणः। गतस्ततो यथाकाम नैष जानाति नैषधम्॥
en: Bahuka said: Having brought here the children of Nala, of golden deeds, he (Varshneya) then repaired to wherever he wished. Indeed, he does not know where the king of the Nishadhas is.

sa: ततोऽहं वचनात् तस्य गिरिमारुह्य शैशिरम्। तपोऽतप्यं महाराज मासं मूलफलाशनः॥
en: Then, following his instructions I ascended the mountain Saisira (Himalayas) and began to practice asceticism, living on fruits and roots in the (first) month.

sa: चर्मभिश्चामरैश्चत्रैः पताकाभिश्च मारिष। छत्रैः सिहतैर्हमदण्डैश्चामरैश्च समन्ततः॥
en: With their armours, variegated standards, chamaras, white umbrellas with golden staves, and lances shattered, O sire,

sa: सोऽभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥ भीमादींश्चापि सम्पूज्य पर्यध्वजत केशवम्।
en: Saluting the feet of his uncle (Dhritarashtra), and then of wise king Yudhishthira the just, and then adoring Bhima and others, he embraced Keshava.

sa: वहन्तं किं तुदसि मां नियुज्य धुरि माहिते। अनार्ये कृत्यमारब्धं किं न पूर्वमुपारुधः॥
en: O worker of mischief, why having laid the load upon me, do you torment me? O ignoble one, why did you not ask for this, when you did first solicit the boon?

sa: ततो राजा सहामात्यः कृष्णश्च यदुनन्दनः॥ धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य तं प्रत्युद्ययतुस्तदा।
en: Then king Yudhishthira with all his ministers, and Krishna, the delighter of the Yadus, placing Dhritarashtra in their van, went out for receiving Dhananjaya.

sa: तत्रैव सर्वे गच्छन्तु भीमसेनपुरोगमाः। तत्रैव सहिताः सर्वे युयुधानरथं प्रति॥
en: Let every one of my troops headed by Bhimasena and others and accompanied by yourself, rush to the spot where Yuyudhana's chariot is stationed.

sa: द्रोणस्य च व्यदृश्यन्त विसर्पन्तो महाशराः। गभस्तय इवार्कस्य प्रतपन्तः समन्ततः॥
en: Like the burning rays of the sun scattering in all sides, the mighty arrows of Drona were then seen to scatter on all directions.

sa: स शरैः शरजालानि वारयन्समरे स्थितः। गभस्तीनिव सूर्यस्य प्रतिजग्राह वीर्यवान्॥
en: That one endowed with prowess stood in the field, resisting those networks of arrows, and took up shafts resembling the rays of the Sun.

sa: सुयोधनो हि सहसा गतो द्रोणेन दंशितः। पूर्वमेवानुयातास्ते कौरवाणां महारथाः॥
en: Accoutered in armour by Drona himself, Suyodhana has suddenly gone behind Arjuna. Ere this, the other mighty car-warriors of the Kauravas have pursued Arjuna.

sa: इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय।।।।।
en: Obtaining you as his son, that graceful (king) has repaired to the region of Indra. Do you bow to him with your brother Lakşmaņa.

sa: अन्तर्बहिश्च यत् किंचिन्मनोव्यासङ्गकारकम्। परित्यज्य भवेत् त्यागी न हित्वा प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: A person becomes a true Renouncer by casting off internal and external attachments, and not simply by leaving home for dwelling in the forest,

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा घोररूपं विशाम्पते।॥ द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे सौबलस्य हसन्निव।
en: The latter, however, O king, easily cut off in twain that terrible scimitar of Subala's son as it went towards him in that skirmish.

sa: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शरैः कनकभूषणैः॥ त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे सहदेवो हसन्निव।
en: With great facility Sahadeva, in that battle, cut off, with his golden arrows, that dart into three pieces as it went swiftly towards him.

sa: अश्वपतिरुवाच अपत्यार्थः समारम्भः कृतो धर्मेप्सया मया। पुत्रा मे बहवो देवि भवेयुः कुलभावनाः॥
en: Ashvapati said : Desirous of attaining virtue, I have observed all these vows so that I may have children. O goddess, many numerous sons, woryour of my race, be born to me.

sa: ततस्ते कथयामासुः कथास्तास्ता मनोरमाः। धन्या दिव्याश्च राजेन्द्र प्रीतिहर्षमुदा युताः॥
en: Then they began to converse cheerfully and delightfully on subjects that delighted one's heart and which were blessed and divine, O chief among kings.

sa: रथमावार्य गदया केशवं समताडयत्। गदया ताडितं दृष्ट्वा केशवं परवीरहा॥
en: Checked the progress of Arjuna's car and with it began to strike Keshava; beholding Keshava struck with the mace, that slayer of hostile heroes.

sa: शरैः सहस्रशोविद्धा विधिवत्कल्पिता द्विपाः॥ शेरते भूमिमासाद्य शैला वज्रहता इव। सवाजिरथमातङ्गान् निजन् व्यचरदर्जुनः॥ प्रभिन्न इव मातङ्गो मृद्गन् नलवनं यथा।
en: Thousands of elephants equipped according to rule, being pierced with numerous arrows. Lay prostrate on the field like so many mountains struck down by the thunder bolt. Then Arjuna careered over the field slaying horses, car-warriors and elephants. Like an elephant in rut crushing a forest of reeds.

sa: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् कृष्णां कमललोचनः॥ कृष्णे न नर्मकालोऽयं क्षुच्छ्रमेणातुरे मयि। शीघ्रं गच्छ मम स्थालीमानीय त्वं प्रदर्शय॥ इति निर्बन्धतः स्थालीमानाय्य स यदूद्वहः। स्थाल्याः कण्ठेऽथ संलग्नं शाकानं वीक्ष्य केशवः॥ उपयुज्याब्रवीदेनामनेन हरिरीश्वरः। विश्वात्मा प्रीयतां देवस्तुष्टश्चास्त्विति यज्ञभुक्॥
en: Thereupon the lotus-eyed god said to Krishna. This is not the time for joke, O Krishna; I am assailed with hunger and fatigue; soon go, fetch the vessel and show me. Having thus got persistently the vessel brought, the ornament of the Yadu race, Keshava, saw a particle of rice and vegetable sticking at a corner. Eating it up he said to her "May the lord Hari, the soul of the universe, be pleased with it and may the God who partakes at sacrifices be satiated with it."

sa: ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नील: सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि॥ अश्मवृष्टिभिरत्युग्रः सूतपुत्रमवाकिरत्।
en: Thereafter the Rakshasa becoming a blue cloud decked with the rain-bow began to cover the son of Suta with a fierce shower of stones.

sa: तावर्जुनो मुहूर्तेन शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। प्रेषयत् परमकुद्धो यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: But Arjuna now excited to the highest pitch of fury, with his arrows of depressed knots, sent them instantly to the abode of Death.

sa: तस्य शब्देन वित्रेसुर्भयार्ताश्च विदुद्रुवुः । मुमुचुश्चाश्रु शोकार्ताः शुशुचुश्चापि सैन्धवाः॥
en: Terror-stricken at the very sound of Gandiva and filled with consternation they fled away. In grief of hear they shed tears and cried aloud.

sa: अहो कामस्य वामत्वं यो गतामपि दुर्लभाम्। स्मारयिष्यति कल्याणी कल्याणतरवादिनीम्॥
en: O how wily is the course of Kāma who has been presenting to my mind that auspicious one, hard to attain and of sweet-accents!

sa: मत्तोऽप्यष्टौ वरानिष्टान् गृहाण त्वं ददामि ते। प्रणम्य शिरसा सा च मयोक्ता पाण्डुनन्दन।॥
en: Do you take from me also eight boons which you choose. I shall, indeed, grant them to you. Bowing her with my head bended, I said to her, O son of Pandu!

sa: भीमनामाङ्किता बाणा: स्वर्णपुलाः शिलाशिताः। विविशुः कर्णमासाद्य च्छिन्दन्त इव जीवितम्॥
en: Then gold-winged arrows, whetted on stone and engraved with the name of Bhima, reaching Karna, penetrated thought him cutting him to the very quick.

sa: तयोः शरैर्महाराज सम्पतद्भिः समन्ततः। बभूव तत्र सैन्यानां संक्षोभः सागरोत्तरः॥
en: An agitation like that produced in the ocean, was then produced in your troops by the arrows of them both, falling on all sides.

sa: शूरा हतभूयिष्ठा हताश्वरथवारणाः। उत्सृज्य भीमकर्णौ च सर्वतो व्यद्रवन् दिशः॥
en: Then those heroes, with their ranks thinned and their horses and elephants slain, fled in all directions, leaving Bhima and Karna on the field.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु कौरवेन्द्रे तं तथा ब्रुवति पाण्डवम्। सर्वेषामेव योधानामार्तनादो महानभूत्॥
en: When that foremost one of Kuru's race was saying so to Yudhishthira, a loud sound of wailing arose from all the warriors there present.

sa: मां हि शोकसमाक्रान्तं संतापयति मन्मथः। हृष्टं प्रवदमानश्च समाह्वयति कोकिलः॥
en: Cupid has been smiting me the more who am stricken with grief, and the cuckoos have been defying me, displaying their mirth, O Laksmana.

sa: तेन विक्षिपतात्यर्थं पवनेन समन्ततः। अमी संसक्तशाखाग्रा ग्रथिता इव पादपाः॥
en: The wind, which was violently shaking them, making the tops of the trees collide with each other, appear as it were stringing them together.

sa: यन्मां दासीप्रवादेन प्रातिकामी तदानयत्। सभापरिषदो मध्ये तन्मां दहति भारत।।२
en: The grief, when Pratikami dragged me in the court in the midst of the courtiers calling me a slave, burns me still, C Bharata,

sa: एवं संसरमाणानि जीवान्यहमदृष्टवान्। यथा कर्म तथ लाभ इति शास्त्रनिदर्शनम्॥
en: I have seen that creatures come and go even thus. The lesson taught in the Scriptures is that one's acquisitions tally with his acts.

sa: संकेताद् भरतेन त्वं रामं समनुगच्छसि। क्रोशन्तं हि यथात्यर्थं नैनमभ्यवपद्यसे॥
en: As you do not go to him albeit he is crying loudly (for help), you follow Rāma in consonance with a hint from Bharata.

sa: सोऽहमेवं विदित्वैतत् प्रपश्यामि शुचिस्मिते। अनपत्यः शुभाँल्लोकान् न प्राप्स्यामीति चिन्तयन्।३०।
en: O lady of sweet smiles, knowing all this, I am certain that sonless as I am, I shall not obtain the regions of felicity.

sa: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम्। प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह॥
en: There upon beyond the sight of men, having taken the highly powerful Lakşmaņa within his body, the king of celestials entered his own city.

sa: ब्राह्मणश्चेन्न विन्देत श्रुतवृत्तोपसंहितः। प्रतिग्रहीता दानस्य मोघं स्याद् धनिनां धनम्॥
en: If there were no Brahmana gifted with Vedic learning and good conduct for accepting gifts, the wealth possessed by rich men would be useless.

sa: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम्। लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः॥
en: O highly illustrious and mighty armed Rāma, I knew before by virtue of my asceticism, of this your present destruction and separation from Laksmana.

sa: अवाङ्मुखोमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम्। राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत्॥
en: There upon beholding Räma with his head downwards and poorly like to the moon possessed by Rāhu, Lakşmaņa, delightedly and with sweet words, said.

sa: समिद्धोऽग्निः शिरस्तस्य बाहू सूर्यनिभौ तथा। त्वड्नेत्रे च सुवर्णाभे कृष्णे जङ्ग्रे च भारत॥
en: Its head was brilliant as the flaming fire, its arms were as bright as the sun; its skin and eyes were gold coloured and its feet, O descendant of Bharata, were black.

sa: अथ गुर्वी महाघोरां हेमचित्रां महागदाम्। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो वैकर्तनरथं प्रति॥
en: Thereupon the highly-puissant Shahadeva, in that engagement, hurled a heavy and formidable mace ornamented with gold, at the car of the son of Vikartana.

sa: प्रववर्ष च तत्रैव सहसा तोयमुल्बणम्। कर्षकस्याचरन् विघ्नं भगवान् पाकशासनः॥
en: Thereupon the illustrious chastiser of Paka (Indra) suddenly poured a very great shower of rains. Thus he caused obstruction to the husband man's work.

sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथा धर्मः सनातनः। व्यवहारप्रवृत्तानां तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Listen, O Yudhishthira, I shall describe to you the eternal practice, obtaining from days of yore, of persons conducting themselves according to approved usages.

sa: यदां च भीमसेनाय प्रवरां प्रददौ तदा। देवदत्तं चार्जुनाय शङ्खप्रवरमुत्तमम्॥
en: He gave to Bhimasena that best of clubs (that was in the lake) he also gave to Arjuna that excellent and the best conch.

sa: तदामात्यानभिप्रेतान् विश्वास्यांश्च गुणान्वितान्। ददावश्वपतिः शीघ्रं भरतायानुयायिनः॥
en: And for following Bharata, Aśvapati without delay assigned a number of goodly, trustworthy, and qualified courtiers.

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ बलिनौ बाहुशलिनौ॥ त्वरया वासुदेवश्च धर्मराजश्च मारिष।
en: When those strong-armed and mighty heroes were thus roaring at each other like two bulls, O sire, Vasudeva and the son of Dharma Yudhishthira,

sa: इत्युक्त्वा संजयं भूयः पर्यपृच्छत भारत। विवित्सुः प्राप्तकालानि ज्ञात्वा परपुरंजयः॥
en: Having thus addressed, he asked again of Sanjaya, O Bharata, desirous of knowing more of the enemies thinking that the proper time has come.

sa: विव्याध चरणे द्रोणमनुमान्य विशाम्यते। क्षत्रधर्मे समास्थाय नवभिः सायकैः पुनः॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, showing due respect to Drona and observing the duties of the Kshatriya order, Arjuna sped at him nine shafts.

sa: यदर्थे यत्नवानेव न लभे विप्रतां विभो। एवंगते तु धर्मज्ञ दातुमर्हसि मे वरम्।॥
en: When such is the case, O righteous one, you should grant me some other boon if, indeed, I have become worthy of your favour or if I have a little of merit!

sa: धनुषः पततस्तस्य सव्यसाचिकराद् विभो। बभूव सदृशं रूपं शक्रचापस्य भारत॥
en: The from of that bow, O king, when it fell from the grasp of Arjuna, resembled, O Bharata, that of the bow of Indra.

sa: त्यजामि पुरातना भवन्तु दास्यस्तव चारुहासिनि। अहं च ते सुन्दरि दासवत् स्थितः सदा भविष्ये वशगो वरानने॥
en: I will renounce all my old wives. Let them be your serving hands, O one of sweet smile. O beautiful one, I will stay as a slave to you and be ever obedient to you, O you of fair face.

sa: यस्तत्र वसतेऽधस्तान्महाहिः काल एव सः। अन्तकः सर्वभूतानां देहिनां सर्वहार्यसौ॥
en: The huge snake living in the bottom of that pit is Time, the destroyer of all embodied beings. It is, indeed, the universal destroyer.

sa: तस्य वृत्रार्दितस्याथ मोह आसीच्छतक्रतोः। रथन्तरेण तं तत्र वसिष्ठः समबोधयत्॥
en: When the god of hundred sacrifices, thus afflicted by Vritra, possessed by stupefaction, the sage Vashishtha restores him to his senses by chanting Samans.

sa: अद्य निष्कौरवामेकः करिष्यामि वसुंधराम्। न हि मे मर्षणीयोऽयमर्जुनस्य व्यतिक्रमः॥
en: I shall alone to-day make the earth free of all Kauravas. Never shall I put up with this insult offered to us by Arjuna."

sa: ततो बुद्धिमुपागम्य भगवान् पाकशासनः। योगेन महता युक्तस्तां मायां व्यपकर्षत॥
en: The illustrious punisher of Paka then, depending upon his intelligence, had recourse to high Yoga and with its help removed these illusions of Vritra.

sa: राजा वसुमना नाम ज्ञानवान् धृतिमाशुचिः। महर्षि परिपप्रच्छ वामदेवं तपस्विनम्॥
en: Once upon a time, king Vasumanas, endued with knowledge, fortitude, purity of conduct, asked the great Rishi Vamadeva of great ascetic merit, sayingधर्मार्थसहितैर्वाक्यैर्भगवन्ननुशाधि माम्।

sa: महता संनिपातेन क्षत्रियान्तकरेण ह। अजयत् पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः करे चैनं न्यवेशयत्॥
en: After a great battle in which great was the slaughter of Kshatriyas, that best of the Pandavas brought the country under his complete control.

sa: द्रष्टुकामाः सभां चैव धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम्। न कश्चिदाहरत् तत्र सहस्रावरमर्हणम्॥
en: Wishing to see that Sabha and also Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, no one came there with less tribute than one thousand (in kind) number of quantity).

sa: हनूमान्शैलशृङ्गाणि शिलाश्च विविधान्दुमान्। ववर्ष कुम्भकर्णस्य शिरस्यम्बरमास्थितः॥
en: And remaining in the sky, Hanumān discharged at Kumbhakarņa's head mountainpeaks and rocks and various trees.

sa: ततो वैकर्तनः कर्णः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। अनेकैरभ्युपायैस्ते जिघांसन्ति स्म पाण्डवान्॥
en: Thereupon the son of the Sun, Karna and the son of Subala, Sakuni, tried by various means to cause the death of the Pandavas.

sa: न चैतानधिजग्मुस्ते समुद्रं समुपाश्रितान्। श्रमं जग्मुश्च परममाजग्मुः क्षयमेव च॥
en: Failing to find them, for the Asuras had taken shelter in the bottom of the ocean, they came back to their homes greatly aggrieved.

sa: एकस्त्वकम्प्यो बलवान्संक्रमः सुमहादृढः। काञ्चनैर्बहुभिः स्तम्भैर्वेदिकाभिश्च शोभितः॥
en: One among these bridges is immovable, strong and fast established; adorned with golden pillars and daises.

sa: प्रययुस्ते ततो भूयस्तीर्थानि वनगोचराः। पुण्येषु तीर्थेषु तथा गात्राण्याप्लावयन्त ते॥
en: After this, those dwellers of the forest went to various other sacred waters. Indeed, going to those sacred waters they performed their ablutions everywhere.

sa: एतेन सहितौ युद्ध्य पञ्चालैश्च महारथैः। आश्वासनार्थं सैन्यानां सर्वेषां पाण्डुनन्दन॥
en: Supported by these and by the mighty carwarrior of the Panchalas, do you proceed to the fight fore-assuring your troops, O delighter of Pandu.

sa: नित्यमस्थिरचित्ता हि कपयो हरिपुंगव। नाज्ञाप्यं विषहिष्यन्ति पुत्रदारं विना त्वया॥
en: But, O foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are always inconstant in character. Bereft of their wives and sons, they shall not bear your behest.

sa: युधिष्ठिरः सभास्तारो मत्स्यानामभवत् प्रियः। तथैव च विराटस्य सपुत्रस्य विशाम्पते॥
en: Yudhishthira as a courtier made himself a favorite to Virata and his son, as well as to all the Matsyas, O lord of people.

sa: तया त्वभिहतो भीमः पुत्रेण तव पाण्डवः॥ नाकम्पत महाराज तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: Thus struck by your son, Bhima, the son of Pandu, did not even quake, O king, and the sight filled all present with wonder.

sa: नोद्यमानस्तदा भीमो दुःखेनैवाकरोन्मतिम्। न हि शक्नोति विवृते प्रत्याख्यातुं नराधिपम्॥
en: Impelled by the king, Bhima made up his mind with reluctance, for it was not in his power to openly disobey the royal mandate.

sa: सर्वे हीमे कौरवेयाः सभायां दुःखान्तरे वर्तमानास्तवैव। न विब्रुवन्त्यार्यसत्त्वा यथावत् पतींश्च ते समवेक्ष्याल्पभाग्यान्॥
en: All the Kurus present in this assembly are floating in the sea of your affliction. They are endued with magnanimity and looking at your husbands they are unable to answer your question.

sa: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिताः। आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्राः कुबेरप्रहिताः स्त्रियः॥ याभिर्गृहीतः पुरुषः सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते।
en: And there came also twenty thousand females sent by Kuvera, decked out in gold and gems, pearls and corals. The sight of these was capable of filling men's mind with enchanting ravishment.

sa: विदुतान् रथिनो दृष्ट्वा निरुत्साहान् द्विषजये। पलायनकृतोत्साहान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are giving way to grief, beholding the car-warriors routed and hopeless of conquering their foes and exert themselves in flying away.

sa: ततोऽनुव्याहृतं श्रुत्वा गते देवे विभावसौ। गृहमागत्य संहृष्टोऽचिन्तयं वै सरस्वतीम्॥
en: Hearing his last words, and after he had departed from where I was, I came home in joy and then remembered the goddess Sarasvati.

sa: अथेह पुरुषव्याघ्र किंचिदन्यच्चिकीर्षसि। तत् प्रब्रूहि करिष्यामो वचनात् तव भारत॥
en: O best of men, O descendant of Bharata, if however, you desire to have any thing else, tell us, we may do your bidding."

sa: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा महर्षिः कार्यविस्तरम्।।।।। वक्तुमद्भुतसंकाशं राघवायोपचक्रमे। मातुलस्ते महाबाहो वाक्यमाह नरर्षभः॥ युधाजित्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते।
en: Hearing those words of Rāma the great saint communicated to him the object of his coming, saying. O you having long arms, if you do like, hear what loving words your maternal uncle Yudhājit, the foremost of men, has said.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दन्तर्वेश्म सहसोत्थाय राजन्। नेदमस्तीत्यथ विदुरो भाषमाणः सम्प्राद्रवद् यत्र पार्था बभूवुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, having said this, Dhritarashtra suddenly rose and went into the inner apartments. Saying "this race is doomed", Vidura (also) went away where the sons of Fandu were.

sa: ततः शचीपतिर्देवः पुनरेव व्यनश्यत। अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां कालाकाक्षी चचार ह॥
en: Then the god, the husband of Sachi again melted himself into the air and invisible by all beings he remained for a fitting opportunity.

sa: आगच्छतस्तान् सहसा क्रुद्धरूपान् सहानुगान्। दधारैको रणे पाण्डून् कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman, single-headed, received in that battle, the enraged Pandava troops who had been rushing to the battle with their followers.

sa: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे दूरं गत्वाप्युदाहर। हा सीते लक्ष्मणेत्येवं रामवाक्यानुरूपकम्॥
en: Kākutstha issuing out of the asylum, you shall, at a great distance utter such cries as O Sītā, O Lakşmaņa imitating his (Rāma's) voice.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महारथः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः सप्तत्या निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior making haste and burning with rage, pierced Bhima whose bow had been severed, on the breast, with seventy sharp arrows.

sa: सोऽहमिन्द्राय दास्यामि कुण्डले सह वर्मणा। यदि मां बलवृत्रघ्नो भिक्षार्थमुपयास्यति॥
en: Therefore I will give the ear-rings together with the armour to Indra. If the slayer of Bala and Vritra comes to me to beg.

sa: मत्स्याञ्जित्वाऽजयच्चेदीन् करूषान् केकयानपि। पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयान् पाण्डून् भारद्वाजः पुनः पुनः॥२९
en: Having vanquished the Matsyas, the son of Bharadvaja obtained victory over the Chedis, the Karusas, the Kekayas, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas and the Pandus.

sa: यथा प्रदीप्तः पुरतः प्रदीपः प्रकाशमन्यस्य करोति दीप्यन्। तथेह पञ्चेन्द्रियदीपवृक्षा ज्ञानप्रदीप्ताः परवन्त एव॥
en: As a lighted lamp, while burning, sees other objects before it, so the five senses which are like lamps fixed on high trees, find out their respective objects when lighted by Knowledge.

sa: क इदानीं महातेजा लयिष्यति सागरम्। क करिष्यति सुग्रीवं सत्यसंधमरिन्दमम्॥
en: What person, endued with exceeding energy, shall now leap over the main? Who shall serve that subduer of enemies, Sugrīva, ever intent on truth?

sa: विषण्णां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा सागरस्य निरीक्षणात्। आश्वासयामास हरीन् भयार्तान् हरिसत्तमः॥
en: That best of monkeys-(Angada), seeing the army cast down because of the sight of the sea, began to comfort the monkeys, afflicted with fear.

sa: नारायणं संनिरीक्ष्य प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना। नमस्कृत्वा महादेवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: With a cheerful soul he looked at Narayana, and bowing to Mahadeva he said these words.

sa: द्रोणस्तु तत् समालोक्य चरितं तस्य संयुगे। मनसा चिन्तयामास प्राप्तकालमरिंदमः॥
en: Then that crusher of foes, Drona, seeing these feats of his enemy in battle, thought in his mind that his (foe's) hour was come.

sa: दैवं पित्र्यं च सततं तस्य विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः। आत्मप्राप्तानि च ततः प्राप्नुवन्ति द्विजोत्तमाः॥
en: Observing all the rites, in full, that were laid down in honor of the gods and the departed manes, all those foremost of twice-born ones acquired all those objects which they sought.

sa: अहं विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा चराम्येष भयादितः। ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं हृतभार्यः सुदुःखितः॥
en: Wronged by my brother, I deprived of my wife and exceedingly distressed, and exercised with fear, live in this foremost of mountains, Rs yamuka.

sa: करन्धमस्य पौत्रस्तु मरुत्तोऽविक्षितः सुतः। कन्यामाङ्गिरसे दत्त्वा दिवमाशु जगाम सः॥
en: Forthwith Maruta the son of Avikshita and the grandson of Karandhama, by giving his daughter in marriage to Angirasa, went to the celestial regions.

sa: कृत्वावहारं सैन्यानां द्रोणः परमदुर्मनाः। दुर्योधनमभिप्रेक्ष्य सव्रीडमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having withdrawn his soldiers, Drona, with a dejected heart, seeing Duryodhana, spoke these words in shame.

sa: विव्याध दशभिस्तूर्णं जयत्सेनं शिलीमुखैः। ननाद सुमहानादं प्रभिन्न इव वारणः॥
en: With great lightness of hands, pierced Jayatsena with ten sharp arrows and then uttered a loud roar like that of an elephants in rut.

sa: तस्मात् प्रत्यक्षदृष्टोऽपि युक्तो ह्यर्थः परीक्षितुम्। परीक्ष्य ज्ञापयत्रर्थान पश्चात् परितप्यते॥
en: You should there scrutinise even things which you see with your own eyes. If a person determines everything after scrutiny, he never regrets afterwards.

sa: चित्रायां तु ददच्छ्राद्धं लभेद् रूपवतः सुतान्। स्वातियोगे पितॄनर्च्य वाणिज्यमुपजीवति॥
en: By performing it under the constellation Chitra one gets beautiful children. By doing it under the constellation Svati, one makes much profit by trade.

sa: क्रोधदीप्तं तु कौन्तेयं द्विषदर्थे समुद्यतम्। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं समेत्यापि महारथाः॥
en: Although those great car-warriors met Bhima, they could not stop that son of Kunti, for filled with anger, he proceeded fiercely towards the enemy.

sa: सार्धं देवगणैः सर्वैर्वाचं तामन्वमोदत। बहुत्वं प्रेक्ष्य सर्पाणां प्रजानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: And he (Brahma), out of kindness for creatures and seeing that the snakes had enormously multiplied, approved of this curse with all the deities.

sa: ये ब्रह्मादीनां खेचराणां क्षितौ च चाधस्तात् संवसन्ते नरेन्द्र। तत्रैव तदर्शनं दर्शयन् वै सम्यक् क्षेम्यं ये पथं संश्रिता वै॥
en: He inculcated the science he had learnt from me to those celestials that live in the regions of Brahman and other gods, unto those who live on Earth, to also the dwellers of the nether regions, and to them who had adopted the path of Liberation, O king.

sa: आत्मना विप्रहीणानि काष्ठकुड्योपमानि च। विनश्यन्ति न संदेहः फेनानीव महार्णवे॥
en: The inert body, which is like a block of wood when destitute of soul, is certainly very short-lived like the forth in the ocean.

sa: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप॥ अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम्। गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानी त्वया सह॥
en: O king, I wish to repair to Ayodhyā your capital with you, in the company of Tārā, the dear wife of Sugrīva as well as of the wives of other leading monkeys.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायुसूनोर्महात्मनः। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता सुरसुतोपमा॥
en: Hearing the speech of the high-souled offspring of the Wind-god, Sītā resembling a daughter of the celestials, said in words fraught with her welfare.

sa: तस्मिन्हते भीमपराक्रमेण प्लवंगमानामृषभेण युद्धे। मही सशैला सवना चचाल भयं च रक्षांस्यधिकं विवेश।१३।।
en: On his being slain, in encounter, by the foremost of monkeys endowed with terrific strength, the earth with her hills and woods, shook; and a mighty fear took possession of the Raksasas.

sa: तस्मिन्हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे हनूमता शक्रपराक्रमेण। नेदुः प्लवंगाः प्रचचाल भूमी रक्षास्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात्॥
en: On Trisiras, enemy of the immortals-having been slain by Hanuman endowed with the prowess itself of Sakra, the monkeys shouted, the earth shook, and the Rākṣas began to fly on all sides.

sa: प्रहर्षमुपनीताश्च वालिपुत्रेण धीमता। आज्ञाप्रतीक्षास्तस्थुश्च सर्वे वानरयूथपाः॥
en: On being cheered by the intelligent son of Vāli, all the monkey-bands stood expecting his commands.

sa: अभिदुद्राव वेगेन गदां तस्य महात्मनः। तां गृहीत्वा गदां भीमामाविध्य च पुनः पुनः॥
en: And taking the terrific mace of the highsouled (Matta) and swinging it again and again, (Risabha) rushed (against the Raksasas). And that high-souled one began to slaughter Matta's forces in the field.

sa: ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र गत्वा रावणमन्दिरम्। न्यवेदयन्पुरीं रुद्धां रामेण सह वानरैः॥
en: Then those Rākşasas, going to that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, informed him that Rāma along with the monkeys had laid siege to the city.

sa: प्रसृताश्च परे त्रस्ता हन्यमाना जघन्यतः। अनुद्रुतास्तु रक्षोभिः सिंहैरिव महाद्विपाः॥
en: And others afflicted with affright, flee, attacked (by the enemy) in the rear, and followed by the Rākṣasas, like mighty elephants pursued by lions.

sa: ततो भिन्नाहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः। तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ ॥
en: Having their weapons baffled thus, those two heroes, gifted with great prowess and effulgence and resembling the burning fire, were ready to interchange blows.

sa: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः। अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च॥
en: O Gudakesha, I am the Self in the heart of every being. I am the beginning the middle and the end of every thing.

sa: सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानी दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे। ततस्त्वां मामको मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम्॥
en: Strike at the same time, O perverse one. Why did you bluster? And then my blow shall despatch you to the mansions of Yama.

sa: स हि तं प्रतिजग्राह भार्याहर्तारमागतम्। कपोतो वानरश्रेष्ठ किंपुनर्मद्विधो जनः॥
en: While a pigeon received so friendly its enemy, the slayer of its mate, how can I then act otherwise, O foremost of the monkeys?

sa: नहि भारः स ते राम रावणः पुत्रपौत्रवान्। सधनुस्तवं हि लोकांस्त्रीन्विजयेथा न संशयः॥
en: Sure, O Rama, it was no great matter for you (to slay) Rāvaņa along with his sons and grandsons. Furnished with your bow, you can, without doubt, destroy the three worlds themselves.

sa: बाणौरर्दिताश्चापि खरपुत्रेण वानराः। संभ्रान्तमनसः सर्वे दुद्रुवुर्भयपीडिताः॥
en: Being thus assailed with fearful arrows by Khara's son, those monkeys, stricken with fear, fled away.

sa: परिश्रमाच्च सुप्ता हे राघवाङ्केऽस्म्यहं चिरम्। पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः॥
en: O Rāghava, I slept for sometime, at your lap, out of exhaustion, and yourself in turn, slept at mine, O elder brother of Bharata.

sa: इति ब्रुवाणं रामस्तु परिष्वज्य विभीषणम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं प्रीतः समुद्राज्जलमानय॥ तेन चेमं महाप्राज्ञमभिषिञ्च विभीषणम्। राजानं रक्षसां क्षिप्रं प्रसन्ने मयि मानद॥
en: There upon, embracing Vibhīşaņa, who spoke thus, Rama, delighted, said to Laksmana, Omy brother, do you bring water from the ocean. Sprinkling the greatly wise Vibhișana, I shall make him at once the king of the Rākşasas, o confrere of honour; for I am greatly pleased with him.

sa: दह्यन्ते भृशमङ्गानि दुरात्मन्मम राघव। यन्मयासि न दृष्टस्त्वं तस्मिन्काले महावने॥
en: O Raghava! O Vicious souled one! My limbs are being burnt (with wrath) for I did not see you then in that mighty forest.

sa: समास्थाय महातेजा रथं हरिरथोपमम्। जगाम सहसा तत्र यत्र युद्धमरिंदमः।।।।
en: Ascending the car, resembling the car of Hari himself, that exceedingly powerful repressor of enemies at once set out for the field of battle.

sa: यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कुर्यादैश्वर्यमास्थितः। पूर्वं चोत्तरकार्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ॥
en: He that dose last what should be done first, and what should be done last, is ignorant of what is prudence and what not.

sa: ते गदाभिः प्रदीप्ताभिः शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः। निजघ्नुर्वानरान्सर्वान्कथयन्तः स्वविक्रमान्॥
en: And displaying their prowess, They* began to slaughter monkeys with maces, and darts, and adzes. *Raksasas.

sa: शोकश्च किल कालेन गच्छता ह्यपगच्छति। मम चापश्यतः कान्तामहन्यहनि वर्धते॥
en: I know that grief abates as time passes by, but my sorrow arising from the separation of my spouse, is increasing day by day.

sa: विरराज समीपस्थं सागरस्य त तद्बलम्। मदुपाण्डुजलः श्रीमान्द्वितीय इव सागरः॥
en: Stationed near the main, the monkey-host in consequence of their resemblance in colour with blue contents of the deep, looked like a second ocean.

sa: स संप्रहारस्तुमुल: संजज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम्। शब्देन महता लङ्कां नादयन्वै समन्ततः॥ शस्त्रैश्च विविधाकारैः शितैर्बाणैश्च पादपैः। उद्यतैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च घोरैराकाशमावृतम्॥
en: There took place a tremendous onslaught of the monkeys and the Raksasas. And Lankā resounded all around with that mighty tumult; and the sky was covered with weapons of various shapes, and whetted arrows and trees and dreadful upraised mountain-tops.

sa: यदि ह्यहं सतीमेनां शोकोपहतचेतनाम्। अनाश्वास्य गमिष्यामि दोषवद् गमनं भवेत्॥
en: And if I go away without soothing this chaste lady, who is almost senseless with grief, I shall be blamed of neglect of duty.

sa: पुण्योत्सवसमृद्धा च नष्टभी सराक्षसा। भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का नष्टभर्ती यथाङ्गना॥
en: This Lankā, which is now full of pious ceremonies, shall, on the death of the Rākṣasas and their master, appear like a husbandless woman.

sa: सा बभूव निशा घोरा हरिराक्षसहारिणी। कालरात्रीव भूतानां सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमा॥
en: That Night, destructive to monkeys and Rākş asas, was dreadful, and difficult of being outsped by all, like to the Fatal Night of beings.

sa: विद्याधरा मदक्षीवा मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः। योषिद्भिःसह संक्रान्ताश्चिक्रीडुर्जहषुश्च वै॥
en: There danced mirthfully, with their damsels, the Vidyādharas, inebriate and having their eyes reddened with drink.

sa: स संप्रहारस्तुमुलः संजज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम्। देवासुराणां क्रुद्धानां यथा भीमो महास्वनः॥
en: That conflict between the monkeys and the Rākşasas, waxed furious, like to the tumultuous encounter of the immortals and the Asuras fired with wrath.

sa: इमामपि विशालाक्षीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा। रावणो नातिवर्तेत वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: As the ocean cannot go beyond its banks so Răvaņa could not approach her having expansive eyes protected by virtue of her own chastity.

sa: प्रभावं सर्वभूतानि विदुरिन्द्रजितो युधि। ततस्तेन महात्मानं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टाः प्रधर्षितम्॥
en: All beings were acquainted with the might of Indrajit in battle; and, therefore, witnessing his discomfiture, and seeing that high-souled one, they refoiced exceedingly.

sa: गृहीत्वा सुमहाशैलं पाणिनैकेन मारुतिः। स विनद्य महानादं भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: And taking that huge hill, the Wind-god's son endowed with prowess, sending up a tremendous roar, began to whirl it with a single arm.

sa: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तमिन्द्रजित्प्रभुणाव्ययम्॥ अथाब्रवीत्स तत्रस्थं मेघनादो महाबलः।
en: Hearing the words uttered by the grandfather, the highly powerful Meghanāda said to the eternal lord.

sa: समीक्षमाणां रुदतीमनिन्दितां सुपक्ष्मताम्रायतशुक्ललोचनाम्। अनुव्रतां राममतीव मैथिली प्रलोभयामास वधाय रावणः॥
en: Beholding that blameless Maithili, having expansive eyes with beautiful eye lashes, greatly attached to Rāma, and weeping Rāvana tempted her for his own destruction.

sa: तोयवेगः : समुद्रस्य समीनमकरो महान्। स बभूव महाघोरः समारुतरवस्तथा॥
en: Then great and exceedingly dreadful was the motion of the sea, with fishes and Makaras, and with the roar of the winds (blowing there).

sa: स प्रमादात्प्रवृद्धस्तेऽधर्मोऽहिर्ग्रसते हि नः। विवर्धयति पक्षं च सुराणां सुरभावनः॥
en: Having grown through through your your neglect, unrighteousness devour us, and that protector of the gods, (righteousness), is strengthening the side of the celestials.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव सर्वदेहभिदः शरान्। भृशमावेशयामास रावणिः समितिंजयः॥
en: That conqueror in battle, Ravana's son, with shafts sorely pierced the persons of Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: एवं चिन्तयतस्तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। पुनरेवापरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महामुनिः॥ मनसथेप्सितं यत्तद्भविष्यति महाहवे। सुखी भव महाबाहो कंचित्कालमुदीक्षय॥
en: The vicious-souled Răvaņa thinking thus the great ascetic, again gave vent to accents. “o you having long arms, what you have desired in your mind shall be encompassed in the great encounter. Be you happy and wait for some time.”

sa: ब्राह्मणास्त्रेण संयोज्य ब्रह्मदण्डनिभं शरम्। संयोज्य धनुषि श्रेष्ठ विचकर्ष महाबलः॥
en: Then fixing an arrow resembling the rod of Brahmā with a Brahmā Mantra, on the best of bows, that exceedingly strong on drew it.

sa: तस्य सा कायमुद्वीक्ष्य वर्धमानं महाकपेः। वक्त्रं प्रसारयामास पातालाम्बरसंनिभम्॥ घनराजीव गर्जन्ती वानरं समभिद्रवत्।
en: Seeing the enlarged body of the mighty monkey, she extended her mouth measuring the sky and the nether regions. And roaring like to a mass of clouds, she rushed against the monkey.

sa: नूनमस्ति महाराज राजभावात्क्षमान्वित। किंचिदात्ययिकं कार्य तेषां त्वं दर्शनं कुरु॥
en: O mighty monarch, surely there is and you are forgiving from your regal sentiment some work which is momentous; and do you see them.

sa: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च रागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन।१६॥
en: O lord of Raksasas, I know your prowess and strength and energy and vigour. Here am I stationed, bow and shafts in hand. Come you. What is the use of vain-glorious self-laudation?

sa: सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम्॥ त्वयाप्युक्तं महाराज न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम्।
en: Be you truthful, O king of Kings, do you look towards me, who am thus begging. You have yourself said, O king, "no fear.”

sa: सागरं सागरानूपान् सागरानूपजान् दुमान्। सागरस्य च पत्नीनां मुखान्यपि विलोकयत्॥
en: He surveyed the sea, and lands bordering thereon, and trees growing on the sea shore, and the countenance of the spouses of the Sea.

sa: शब्दश्च सुमहांस्तेषां नर्दतामभिधावताम्॥ श्रूयते तुमुलो युद्धे न रूपाणि चकाशिरे।
en: The fierce cries alone of those roaring and rushing were heard in that dreadful battle; but their forms were not visible to the sight.

sa: चारेण विदितः शत्रुः पण्डितैर्वसुधाधिपैः। युद्धे स्वल्पेन यत्नेन समासाद्य निरस्यते।२१।।
en: The wise king that gathers (a knowledge of) his enemy through spies, can, putting forth a modicum of effort in conflict, neutralise (his exertions).

sa: ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम्। प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समवर्तत॥
en: The army of Räkşasas and the mighty host of the monkeys although they had weapons in their hands, became stupefied (for the time being).

sa: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं बद्धं कपिवरोत्तमम्। राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: And the Rākṣasas related to the ruler of Rākșas everything touching that foremost of choice monkeys, resembling a mad elephant who was in bonds.

sa: न कामान च लोभाद्वा न भयात्पार्थिवात्मज। रागानक्राकुलजलं स्तम्भयेयं कथंचन॥
en: O king's son, not from desire, covetousness, or fear, or anger, can I anywise deprive my waters abounding in alligators of their (perpetual) motion.

sa: तमब्रवीत्तदा रामः शृणु मे वरुणालय। अमोघोऽयं महाबाणः कस्मिन्देशे निपात्यताम्॥
en: Then Rāma said, O Varuna's abode, listen to me! This arrow (of mine) must accomplish the end (intended). Where shall I let it light?

sa: शिरसा मे शिरश्चास्य कायं कायेन योजय। रावणानुगमिष्यामि गतिं भर्तुर्महात्मनः॥
en: Do you join my head to his and my body to his body. I will, O Rāvana, follow the way of my high-souled lord.

sa: तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन्। गत्वा च महदध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम्॥ दक्षिणं तीरमुदधेर्लङ्का यत्र गता पुरी।
en: Having slain her, I again remembering the delay that had occurred touching my work, set out on the great road, and at length saw the southern shore of the sea, covered with mountains, where is situated the city of Lankā.

sa: न च शक्तः सुदुष्टात्मा मनसापि हि मैथिलीम्। प्रधर्षयितुमप्राप्यां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: The greatly vicious-souled one could not even by his mind get Maithili, who was beyond his reach like to the burning flame of fire.

sa: दृष्टः कश्चिदुपायो मे सीतोपस्थानकारकः। रुचितश्चेतस्वया बुद्ध्या राक्षसेन्द्र ततः शृणु॥
en: I have perceived a way as to how Sītā may smile upon you. Do you listen: and should it please you; act you accordingly.

sa: राक्षसीवशमापना भय॑माना च दारुणम्। चिन्तयन्ती सुदुःखार्ता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥
en: A captive of the Rākşasis, subject to their terrible threats and taunts, sunk in grief and anxiety, I desire not to keep my life.

sa: उवाच च महातेजाः सुग्रीवं राघवानुजः। अभिषेकाय रामस्य दूतानाज्ञापय प्रभो॥
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent younger brother of Raghava spoke to Sugriva, saying, "Do you, O lord, order some (to bring water) for Rama's installation."

sa: तथा प्रत्यूषसमये चतुणां सागराम्भसाम्। पूर्णैर्घटैः प्रतीक्षध्वं तथा कुरुत वानराः॥
en: "Do you so conduct, O monkeys, that you may return by the dawn with the jars filled with the water of the four oceans."

sa: अद्य दीर्घस्य कालस्य भविष्याम्यहमाशिता॥ इदं मम महासत्त्वं चिरस्य वशमागतम्।
en: Today after a long lapse of time I shall have my fare. This mighty creature has after a long time come within my power.

sa: चिच्छेद केतुमुद्दिश्य शरेणैकेन रावणः। पातयित्वा रथोपस्थे रथात्केतुं च काञ्चनम्॥ ऐन्द्रानपि जघानाश्वाञ्शरजालेन रावणः।
en: And with an arrow, Rāvana severed the standard; and having brought down the golden standard on the floor of the car, Rāvaņa wounded even Indra's steeds with a net-work of arrows. were

sa: तं पद्मदलपत्राक्षं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम्। धन्याः पश्यन्ति मे नाथं कृतज्ञं प्रियवादिनम्॥
en: Oh blest are they who have been resting their eyes upon my grateful and sweet-speeched lord of leonine gaits, having eyes resembling lotus petals!

sa: अर्जुनस्य गदा सा तु णत्यमानाहितोरसि। काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा॥
en: Being placed against the breast of Rāvaņa Arjuna's club rendered, for a moment, the welkin look like the burning gold as does the lightning.

sa: तेन मामद्य संयुक्तं रथस्थमिह संयुगे। प्रतीयात्कोऽद्य मामाजौ साक्षादपि पुरन्दरः॥
en: Today who will come forward against me in battle accoutred in that and mounted on a car in the conflict? Not even Purandara himself.

sa: तत्र रावणमासाद्य अभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। आचचक्षे प्रियं पित्रे निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: And approaching Rāvana and saluting him with joined hands, he informed his sire of the welcome tidings that Răma and Lakṣmaṇa had been slain.

sa: साब्रवीन्मां ततो देवी नैष धर्मो महाकपे। यत्ते पृष्ठं सिषेवेऽहं स्ववशा हरिपुङ्गव ॥
en: Whereto she replied — 'This is not the pious course, O great monkey, O you the foremost of your race, that I shall, of my own accord, place myself on your back.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राघवेण महात्मना॥ तथेत्युक्त्वा सुसंहृष्टः सौवर्णं घटमाददे। तं घटं वानरेन्द्राणां हस्ते दत्त्वा मनोजवान्॥ व्यादिदेश महासत्त्वः समुद्रसलिलं तदा।
en: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Raghava, the son of Sumitra, saying, “So be it" and greatly delighted, brought a golden jar. And placing that jar at the hands of the lord of monkeys, that one, gifted with great energy, ordered them to bring water from the Ocean.

sa: दीर्घायुश्च महात्मा च ब्रह्मा तं प्राब्रवीद्वचः। सर्वेषां ब्रह्मदण्डानामवध्यत्वं भविष्यति।२०॥
en: And Brahmă bestowed his blessings upon him saying that he will live long and will be invulnerable to all the weapons invented by Brahma.

sa: मृत्युतस्ते भयं नास्ति वरान्मम विहंगम। यावत्त्वां न वधिष्यन्ति नरास्तावद्भविष्यसि॥
en: O bird, from my curse fear of death shall not approach you; and you shall exist so long as people do not slay you.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो वायुसुतो रावणं समभिद्रवत्। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना॥
en: Then the Wind-god's offspring waxing wroth rushed at Rāvana, and overwhelmed with rage smote at his chest with his clenched fist resembling the thunderbolt.

sa: अथ संगृह्य वेगेन गरुत्मानिव पन्नगम्। स तु शीघ्रं बिलद्वारं संप्रविश्य त दुर्मति॥ प्रविवेश च तद्द्वारं रावणो निर्भयस्तदा। स प्रविश्य च पश्यद्वै नीलाञ्जनचयोपमान्॥ केयूरधारिण शूरारक्तमाल्यानुलेपनान्। वरहाटकरत्नाद्यैर्विविधैश्च विभूषितान्॥ दृश्यन्ते तत्र नृत्यन्त्यस्तिस्रः कोट्यो महात्मनाम्। नृत्योत्सवा वीतभया विमलाः पावकप्रभाः॥ नृत्यन्त्यः पश्यते तांस्तु रावणो भीमविक्रमः। द्वारस्थौ रावणस्तत्र तासु कोटिषु निर्भयः॥ यथा दृष्टः स तु नरस्तुल्यांस्तानपि सर्वशः। एकवर्णानेकवेषानेकरूपान्महौजसः॥ चतुर्भुजान्म
en: As Garuda goes speedily taking a serpent so that vicious-minded Rāvana arrived quickly at the entrance of the den. And Ravana, having no fear, entered therein. And having entered there he saw males resembling the red collyrium, wearing Keyüras,* heroic, be-decked with red garlands, pasted with red sandal and adorned with diverse golden ornaments and jewels. He saw there three millions, of such high-minded persons. devoid of fear, pure, radiant like fire, dancing being mad after festivities. Beholding them the Ten-necked demon, of dreadful prowess, was not the least terrified and rather saw their dance, standing at the gate. They were all like the male being he had seen before. They were all of the same colour, same dress, same figure and equally gifted with great energy. They were all gift

sa: तस्य पुत्रः प्रियो ज्येष्ठस्ताराधिपनिभाननः। रामो नाम विशेषज्ञः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: His eldest and most beloved son was the Moon-bright Rāma, wise and the foremost of those who know the science of the bended bow.

sa: विज्ञाप्यः पुनरप्येष रामो वायुसुत त्वया। अखिलेन यथा दृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी॥ अयं चास्मै प्रदातव्यो यत्नात् सुपरिरक्षितः।
en: And Jānakī addressing me said'O Windgod's son, do you describe everything of what you have seen here, to Rāma. And relating everything before Sugrīva, do you present him with this jewel which has been preserved by me with great care.

sa: ता हि सर्वाः समं दुःखान्मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम्। तुल्यमवयर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसंभवम्॥ ताभिः सर्वानवद्याभिनंदीभिरिव सागरः। आपूरितं विमानं तद्भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः॥
en: They, all afflicted, shed tears, hot as fiery flames, caused by fear and fire of grief. As the ocean is filled with the currents of the rivers so that car was flooded with their tears originating from fear and sorrow.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम्॥ अथारुरोह सहसा हनूमन्तं महाकपिम्।
en: Hearing the words spoken by Hanumān, Rāghava at once got up on that gigantic monkey; and that master of men beheld Rāvana in battle.

sa: अद्य निर्वानरामुर्वी हत्वा रामं च लक्ष्मणम्। करिष्ये परमां प्रीतिमित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत॥
en: Destroying Rāma and Lakşmaņa, and clearing the monkeys off the earth, shall I satisfy my sire greatly. Saying this, he disappeared from their view.

sa: अवश्यं चापि लोकेषु सीता पावनमर्हति। दीर्घकालोषिता हीयं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा॥
en: Beautiful (Sītā) lived in the inner apartment of Rāvana for a long time so she needs this purification in the presence of all people.

sa: यं तस्मै प्रथमं प्रादादगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। ब्रह्मदत्तं महद्वाणममोघं युधि वीर्यवान्॥
en: The great Rși Agastya first conferred this upon him. This is a huge and dreadful shaft given by Brahma and highly useful in battle.

sa: नहि दृष्टिपथं प्राप्य राघवस्य रणे रिपुः। जीवन्प्रतिनिवर्तेत यद्यपि स्यान्मनोजवः॥
en: Coming in battle within ken of Raghava, a foe, even if he be endowed with the fleetness of thought, does not go back living.

sa: अद्य पर्वतसंकाशं ससूर्यमिव तोयदम्। विकीर्णं पश्य समरे सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्॥
en: To-day behold the lord of monkeys-Sugrivaresembling a mountain or a mass of clouds lighted up by (the living) sun, lying stretched on the field.

sa: ततः स योजनशतं प्रविष्टो राक्षसाधिपः। देवतानां बलं सर्वं शरवरवाकिरत्॥
en: Thereupon having entered into the army up to a hundred leagues the lord of Rākşasas overpowered the celestial host with a downpour of shafts.

sa: नैतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं मयि जीवति पार्थिव। तमहं नाशयिष्यामि यत्कृते परितप्यते॥
en: O king, so long as I live, you must not suffer your heart to fare thus. Him will I slay for whom you grieve.

sa: शरजालांशुमाञ्छूरः कपे रामदिवाकरः। शत्रुरक्षोमयं तोयमुपशोषं नयिष्यति॥
en: O monkey, Rāma the Sun, with his arrow-like rays, shall dry up the water-the inimical Rākşasas.

sa: मुक्तमिन्द्रजिता तत्तु शरवर्षमरिंदमः। आवारयदसंभ्रान्तो लक्ष्मणः सुदुरासदम्॥
en: Thereat Laksmana, subduer of enemies, retaining his calmness, resisted that powerful arrows shower shot by Indrajit.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः। भर्ल्सयन्ति स्म परुषैर्वाक्यै रावणचोदिताः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sītā, all those Rākşasīs despatched by Rāvana, almost beside themselves with ire, again covered her with reproaches rough and rude.

sa: ते वानरा गर्वितहृष्टचेष्टाः संग्राममासाद्य भयं विमुच्य। युद्धं स्म सर्वे सह राक्षसैस्ते नानायुधाश्चक्रुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥
en: Those monkeys, equipped with various weapons and with their vigour unworn, entering upon the conflict casting off fear, cheerfully putting forth efforts springing from pride of spirit, warred on with the Räkşasas.

sa: भर्त्तितामपि याचध्वं राक्षस्यः किं विवक्षया। राघवाद्धि भयं घोरं राक्षसानामुपस्थितम्॥
en: YouRaksasis! You have threatened her, do youimplore her forgiveness—no more with harsh words. Forsooth, from Rāghava shall proceed the mighty disaster of the Rākṣasas.

sa: सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतशीर्षो महर्षभः। त्वं त्रयाणां हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयंप्रभुः॥
en: You are the foremost of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred regulations. You are yourself the creator of the three worlds, O lord.

sa: नदी गज इव क्रीडन्वृक्षान्वायुरिव क्षिपन्। नगान्वज्र इवोत्सृष्टो विध्वंसयति राक्षसः॥
en: That Rākşasa spread destruction, even as an elephant sporting agitates a river, as the wind bring down trees, or as the thunder-bolt rive mountain-peaks.

sa: अर्थसिद्धिं तु वैदेह्याः पश्याम्यहमुपस्थिताम्। राक्षसेन्द्रविनाशं च विजयं राघवस्य च॥
en: Verily I do perceive, before me, the satisfaction of Vaidehi's end, the destruction of the lord of the Rākşasas and the conquest of Raghava.

sa: कथं नु खल्वद्य भवेत् सुखागतं प्रसह्य युद्धं मम राक्षसैः सह। तथैव खल्वात्मबलं च सारवत् समानयेन्मां च रणे दशाननः॥
en: How can my arrival (at this place) be made to bring forth good fruit? How can I forcibly bring on engagement with the Rākşasas? And how can the Ten-necked one in battle be made to form a just estimate of the respective strength of myself and his forces?

sa: अभिपेतुश्च गर्जन्तो राक्षसान्वानरर्षभाः। परिवार्य हनूमन्तमन्वयुश्च महाहवे॥
en: Roaring thus the leading monkeys advanced towards the Rākşasas and stood encircling Hanumān in the battle-field.

sa: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप॥ अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम्। गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानी त्वया सह॥
en: O king, I wish to repair to Ayodhyā your capital with you, in the company of Tārā, the dear wife of Sugrīva as well as of the wives of other leading monkeys.

sa: क्षमा ते पृथिवीतुल्या तेजसा भास्करोपमः। वेगस्ते वायुना तुल्यो गाम्भीर्यमुदधेरिव॥
en: Your patience equals that of earth, your effulgence equals that of the sun, your velocity equals the wind and your gravity resembles the deep.

sa: स भर्तुर्वचनं श्रुत्वा निष्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा। अनीकान्मेघसंकाशादंशुमानिव वीर्यवान्॥
en: Hearing his master's speech, Angada descended from that host resembling clouds, like the powerful Sun himself.

sa: ते तस्य वज्रप्रतिमाः शराः सर्वविषोपमाः।। विलयं जग्मुरागत्य कवचं काञ्चनप्रभम्॥
en: And his shafts resembling thunder-bolts, and like to all varieties of venom, touching (Lakş mana's) mail having a golden splendour, were reduced to naught.

sa: प्रविष्टः सत्रुसैन्यं हि प्राप्तः शत्रुरतर्कितः। निहन्यादन्तरं लब्ध्वा उलूको वायसानिव॥
en: Forsooth has an enemy entered secretly in our midst and he shall slay us getting an opportunity like to an owl killing the crows.

sa: तलं राक्षसेन्द्राणां महाभ्रघननादितम् ॥ जयेप्सया देवलोकं ययौ मालिवशे स्थितम्।
en: Under the command of Māli that host of Raksasas, roaring like mighty clouds, inspired with the desire of victory, went to the celestial regions.

sa: महाविम समरे मया सह तवाद्भुतम्। अद्य भूतानि पश्यन्तु शक्रशम्बरयोरिव॥
en: Today let all creatures witness the mighty and wonderful encounter in conflict between you and me, like to the meeting of Śakra and Sambara.

sa: आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ चापमिन्द्रारिराहवे। मुमोच तं शरं क्रुद्धस्त्रिपुरे शंकरो यथा॥
en: And enraged, (Ravana) resembling Rudra himself, in fight drawing his bow to his car, discharged that shaft even as Sankara had discharged at Tripura.

sa: अतिकायस्य नादेन तेन तस्य दुरात्मनः। सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः सागरश्च प्रचुक्षुभे॥
en: And at the roars of that wicked-minded and huge-bodied one, all creatures were struck with terror, and the sea was vexed.* *The still-vexed Bermoothes.'-Tempest.

sa: सुकृतौ कर्णवेष्टौ च श्वदंष्ट्रौ च सुसंस्थितौ। मणिविदुमचित्राणि हस्तेष्वाभरणानि च।॥
en: I behold on her ears excellent ear-rings and nicely placed Svadangstras and on her arms jewelled ornaments rendered dark-blue by dirt for constant use.

sa: कुशली तव काकुत्स्थः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ गुरोराराधने युक्तो लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः। तस्य वीर्यवतो देवि भर्तुस्तव हिते रतः।७४।।
en: It is all well with your Kākuthstha, the foremost of those using weapons, as well as with Laksmana, O worshipful dame, gifted with auspicious marks, engaged in the worship of his superiors and in the well being of your lord.

sa: तां सुरैरपि दुर्धर्षां रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः। यथा निदेशं संपीड्य न्यविशन्त वनौकसः॥
en: And urged on by Rāma's command, the wood-raingers,* as commanded, blocking up (Lankā) incapable of being subdued even by the gods, stationed themselves. *Monkeys.

sa: द्वारमुत्तरमासाद्य चिन्तयामास वानरः॥ कैलासनिलयप्रख्यमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम्। ध्रियमाणमिवाकाशमुच्छ्रितैर्भवनोत्तमैः॥ सम्पूर्णां राक्षसै।रैर्गुहामाशीविषैरिव। तस्याश्च महतीं गुप्तिं सागरं च निरीक्ष्य सः। रावणं च रिपुं घोरं चिन्तयामास वानरः॥ आगत्यापीह हरयो भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः। नहि युद्धेन लङ्का शक्या जेतुं सुरैरपि॥
en: And arriving at the Northern gate resembling the mansion of Kailāsa, and cleaving, as it were, the welkin, and as if holding the firmament with lofty and glorious edifices, and observing the sea; his dreadful enemy, Ravana; the city teeming with poisonous snakes, as well as the method of defence (displayed in it)-the monkeys reflected, Even if the monkeys came here, they should fail to achieve success; for Lankā is incapable of being taken in battle by the celestials themselves.

sa: इह प्राप्तान्वयं सर्वाञ्छबूंस्तव महाबल। वशं शस्त्रप्रतापेन करिष्यामो न संशयः॥
en: O highly powerful one, we shall, without doubt, by the prowess of our arms, subdue all these enemies of your that have come hither.

sa: सर्वे विकृतलाङ्गलाः सर्वे दंष्ट्रानखायुधाः। सर्वे विकृतचित्राङ्गाः सर्वे च विकृताननाः॥
en: All had their tails curled up, and all were armed with teeth and nails, and all had chequered bodies, and all had frightful faces.

sa: हयोत्तमसमायुक्तं सर्वायुधसमाकुलम्। आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः॥
en: Ravana's son-Trisiras, ascended a car yoked with excellent steeds, and furnished with every variety of arms.

sa: लब्धकामस्य ते पश्चादागमिष्यति किं भयम्। प्राप्तमप्राप्तकालं वा सर्व प्रतिविधास्यसे॥
en: When you have attained your purpose; what fear can succeed? Alike when on your guard, and off it, you shall provide against all exigencies.

sa: पुत्रकस्य यशः पीतं नाम विश्रावितं त्वया। मद्वाक्याद्याच्यमानोऽद्य मुञ्च वत्सदशाननम्॥
en: Having drunk up the glories of my son you have announced your own; so I do say, O my son, do you release Dasanana.

sa: इत्येवं परिपृष्टास्ते स्वं स्वं मतमतन्द्रिताः। सोपचारं तदा राममूचुः प्रियचिकीर्षवः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma (to minister to him best counsels) all those monkeys, intent upon encompassing his well-being, gave out their respective opinions.

sa: अर्थानौँ विनिश्चित्य व्यवसायं भजेत ह। गुणतः संग्रहं कुर्याद्दोषतस्तु विसर्जयेत्॥
en: It is always proper to engage in actions, considering what is right and what is wrong. Virtues should always be gathered and vices abondoned.

sa: आरुह्य गिरिसंकाशं प्रासादं हरियूथपः। बभौ स सुमहातेजाः प्रतिसूर्य इवोदितः॥
en: And having ascended the edifice resembling a mountain, that leader of monkey-bands, possessed of wondrous energy, looked like another Sun risen (in the sky).

sa: सम्प्रधृष्य तु दुर्धर्षश्चैत्यप्रासादमुन्नतम्। हनूमान् प्रज्वलँल्लक्ष्या पारियात्रोपमोऽभवत्॥
en: Having broken down that superb edifice, the irrepressible Hanuman, flaming in auspiciousness, resembled (the mountain) Pāriyatra.

sa: एभिः प्रधर्षणायां च वारितं वनपालकैः। मामप्यचिन्तयन् देव भक्षयन्ति वनौकसः॥
en: They were prevented, O lord, in their act of devastation, by these guards, but those monkeys, without caring for me the least, feasted there.

sa: ब्रवीमि त्वां हितं वाक्यं क्रियतामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। सुदृष्टा क्रियतां लङ्का जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम्॥
en: It is all this for your good; do you perform acts for the good of your body surviving death; and do you see Lankā well; for your life is in my keeping.

sa: ते समेत्य सभायां वै राक्षसा राजशासनात्। यथार्हमुपतस्थुस्ते रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Presenting themselves agreeably to the command of the monarch, they sat them down each according to his position, before the lord of Raksasas, Ravana.

sa: विभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम्। शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणो यथा॥
en: Even as fountains flow from the sides of a hill, blood flowed profusely from the person of that one, whose head had been riven.

sa: सा पुरी परमाकीर्णा रथकुञ्जरवाजिभिः। संपतद्भिर्विरुरुचे गरुत्मद्भिरिवाम्बरम्॥
en: And like the welkin filled with fowls, the city thronged with approaching cars, elephants and steeds.

sa: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं समरे दृढधन्विनोः। यादृशं ह्यभवद् राजञ्जम्भवासवयोः पुरा॥
en: (And) between those two strong bowmen ensued a battle, Oking, like that which had taken place between Bali and Vasava in days of yore.

sa: कृपुश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रौणिश्चैव महारथः॥ एते रक्षान्ति राजानं सूतपूत्रेण रक्षिताः। अवध्यमानास्तेऽस्माभिर्घातयिष्यन्ति सोमकान्॥
en: Karna is protecting Kripacharya, Kritavarman and Ashvatthama, while those great warriors are protecting the king Duryodhana in their turn; and unless we resist them they will cause a massacre among the Somakas.

sa: हस्तिहस्तान् हयग्रीवान् रथाक्षांश्च समन्ततः। शोणिाक्तान् हयारोहान् गृहीतप्रासतोमरान्॥ क्षुरैश्चिच्छेद बीभत्सुधैिकैकं त्रिधैव च। हया वारणमुख्याश्च प्रापतन्त समन्ततः३७॥
en: Vibhatsu also cut-off the trunks of elephants, the necks of steeds, the axels of cars and also horses and men steeped in blood and armed with lances, in two or three fragments with his Kshurapras. And horses and excellent elephants.

sa: एकैकं दशभिबाणैः सर्वानेव समापर्यत्। तं द्रौणिः पञ्चविंशत्या वृषसेनश्च सप्तभिः॥
en: He pierced every one of your warriors with nine arrows. Thereupon Drona's son pierced him with twenty-five arrows and Vrishasena pierced him with seven.

sa: शैनेयस्तु रणे क्रुद्धस्तव पुत्रं महारथम्। सायकानामशीत्या तु विव्याधोरसि भारत॥
en: O Bharata, then the grandson of Shini, worked up with rage, pierced your mighty son with a group of eighty shafts on the chest.

sa: अत्यद्भुतमहं मन्ये पाण्डवेयस्य विक्रमम्। यदेकः समरे सर्वान् योधयामास मामकान्॥
en: The powers of Pandu's son seem to me to be most extraordinary that he could fight single-handed against all the warriors of my army.

sa: शकुनिश्चार्जुनं राजन् परिवार्य समन्ततः। रथैरनेकसाहस्रैर्गजैश्चापि सहस्रशः॥
en: O king, meanwhile Shakuni surrounding Arjuna on all sides with countless cars and thousands of elephants.

sa: अताड्यदुलूकं च त्रिभिरेव तथा शरैः। उलूकस्तु तथा विद्धो वासुदेवमताड्यत्॥
en: He then angrily pierced Uluka in that battle with his arrows. Thus having pierced Uluka even before the very eyes of Subala's son, Arjuna.

sa: व्यधमत् कौरवीं सेनामासुरीं मघवानिव। वध्यमाने बले तस्निस्तव पुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Began to agitate the Kaurava host like Indra agitating the Asura host. O sire when the troops of your son were thus being carnaged.

sa: क्षेमधूर्तिस्तु संक्रुद्धः कैकेयस्य महात्मनः। धनुचिच्छेद भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन ह॥
en: Thereat Kshemadhurti excited the highest pitch of fury, cut-off the bow of the illustrious ruler of the Kekayas with a welltempered and well-sharpened arrow.

sa: तत्र पार्थस्य भुजयोर्महद्बलमदृश्यत। यत् क्रुद्धो बहुलाः सेनाः सर्वतः समवारयत्॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful might of Partha's arms inasmuch as inflamed with wrath, he held in check, the numerous army of the Kauravas.

sa: विधुन्वतश्च चापानि सर्वतः प्रत्यवारयन्। श्लिष्टं च सर्वतश्चक्रू रथमण्डलमाशु ते॥
en: Shaking their bows, they encompassed him on all sides and they also made their chariots to be drawn in a compact circle around him.

sa: सर्वे तु प्रतिसंरब्धा ह्रीमन्तः सत्त्वचोदिताः। स्थिरीभूता महात्मानः प्रत्यगच्छन् धनंजयम्॥
en: After a while, however, those illustrious warriors, overwhelmed with wrath and shame and urged on by their prowess, gathered courage and rushed upon Dhananjaya.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु तं रथं युक्तं कवची स शरासनी। बाणमादाय तं दिव्यं सोमविष्णवग्निसम्भवम्॥
en: Seeing that car furnished with all its equipment's, he, coated himself with the armour and armed with the bow, took up that celestial arrow sprung from the deities, Soma, Vishnu and Agni.

sa: पश्य कर्णेन हैडिम्बे पाण्डवानामनीकिनी। काल्यमाना यथा गावः पालेन रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Behold, O son of Hidimba, the hosts of the Pandavas afflicted by Karna in battle like a herd of kine belaboured by the keeper.

sa: नकुलस्तं तु विंशत्या विद्ध्वा भारसहैईलैः। ननाद बलवन्नादं कर्णस्य भयमादधत्॥
en: Striking his antagonist with twenty strong arrows capable of bearing a strain Nakula too sent up a loud war-cry and struck terror unto Karna.

sa: वधार्थ चास्य समरे सायकं सूर्यवर्चसम्। चिक्षेप त्वरया युक्तस्त्वराकाले धनंजयः॥
en: Then with his arrows, Fritha's son scattered the unrivaled shower of arrows that proceeded from Karna's bow, like the tempest scattering masses of clouds.

sa: कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे राक्षसेन युयुत्सति। रक्ष कर्णं रणे यत्तो वृतः सैन्येन मानद॥
en: Karna the son of Vikartana is fighting with the Rakshasa. O bestower of honor, putting forth your best energies in battle and supported by the troops do you protect Karna in battle.

sa: विद्ध्वा च बहुभिर्बाणैर्भमसेनि महाबलः। व्यद्रावयच्छरवातैः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Quickly covered him with myriads of shafts. Piercing the son of Bhimasena with numerous arrows, Alambusha.

sa: अद्य चाहमनाधृष्यं केशवाप्रतिमं शरम्। उत्स्त्रक्ष्यामीह यः कर्णं जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति॥
en: O Keshava, I will fling today such an irresistible arrow, unique of its kind, that will surely make Karna shuffle off his mortal coil.

sa: तेन ह्यस्य प्रतिज्ञातं भीमसेनमहं युधि। हन्तेति स्वयमागम्य स्मरता वैरमुत्तमम्॥
en: Alayudha, having come to Duryodhana out of his own accord, recollecting his old enmity, has said to the latter, that he would slay Bhima.

sa: ईदृशं सात्यकिं संख्ये निर्जित्य च महारथम्। अधिकत्वं विजानीषे स्ववीर्यवशमागतम्॥
en: And having thus obtained advantage over him, you seek to establish your superiority. You desired to cut-off with your sword the head of Satyaki.

sa: सम्पूज्यमानो युधि कौरवेयैनिर्जित्य संख्येऽरिगणान् सहस्रशः। व्यरोचत द्रोणसुतः प्रतापवान्। यथा सुरेन्द्रोऽरिगणान् निहत्य वै॥
en: Highly adored by the Kauravas after having vanquished thousands of enemies in battle, the puissant son of Drona shone like the lord of the celestials himself after the destruction of his foes.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः पञ्चालाः समरे सह संजयैः॥ अगच्छन् द्रौणिमुत्सृज्य विकीर्णरथध्वजाः।
en: Thus slaughtered in battle, the Panchalas together with the Srinjayas fled from the son of Drona, on their cars with their standards cut down.

sa: द्रौणिर्दुपदपुत्रस्य फाल्गुनस्य च पश्यतः॥ नाशयामास पञ्चालान् भूयिष्ठं ये व्यवस्थिताः।
en: In the very presence of Phalguna and of the son of Drupada, the son of Drona slaughtered all those Panchalas who had confronted him.

sa: तस्मिन् हते हता हि स्युः सर्वे पाण्डवसृञ्जयाः। एकवीरवधे कस्माद् युद्धे न जयमादधे॥
en: Had Arjuna been slain by that Sakti, then all the Srinjayas and Pandavas also would have be slain. Indeed, if Phalguna could have been slain, then victory certainly would have been ours.

sa: सचर्मणः पदातीनां रथीनां च सधन्वनः सप्रतोदान् नियन्तॄणां बाहूंश्चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥
en: Those of foot-soldiers with shields; those of car-warriors with bows; and those drivers, with whips and hooks, the son of Pandu then cut-. off.

sa: हन्याद् रथसहस्राणि एकैकेनैव मुष्टिना॥ लक्षं नरद्विपान् हत्वा समेतान् समहाबलान्।
en: Discharging flights of shafts at a time he struck down thousands of charioteers. He killed in all a hundred thousand powerful men and elephants.

sa: तवापि समतिक्रान्तमेतद् गावल्गणे कथम्। एतमर्थं महाबुद्धे यत् त्वया नावबोधितः॥
en: Why, O Gavalgani's son, did you too forget this great object, since endued as you are with great intelligence, you did not remind Karna?

sa: अद्य सप्तदशाहानि वर्तमानस्य भारत। विनाशस्यातिघोरस्य नरवारणवाजिनाम्॥
en: Today, O Bharata, is the seventeenth day of this horrible carnage of men, elephants and horses.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः पुनरमेयात्मा केशवोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्। कृतसंकल्पमायन्तं वधे कर्णस्य भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said O Bharata, then again did Kesava of magnanimous heart address the following words to Arjuna, who was proceeding resolutely to slay Karna.

sa: आत्मानं मन्यते वीरं येन पापः सुयोधनः। तमद्य मूलं पापानां जहि सौतिं धनंजय॥
en: O Dhananjaya, the sinful Suyodhana poses himself as a hero only counting upon Karna's valour. Do you today strike at the root of all evils by slaying down that son of Suta.

sa: निशीथे पाण्डवं सैन्यमेतत् सैन्यप्रमर्दितम्। गजाभ्यामिव मत्ताभ्यां यथा नलवनं महत्॥
en: Lo! at this dead hour of night, the Pandava army is being crushed like a forest of reeds by two infuriate elephants in rut.

sa: धनुषो ह्यस्य कर्माणि दिव्यानि प्राह भार्गवः। तद् रामो ह्यददन्मह्यं तेन योत्स्यामि पाण्डवम्॥४७
en: The son of Bhrigu speaks of the celestial deeds of that formidable bow. As Rama has given it to me I will surely fight with the son of Pandu with that bow.

sa: अभ्यद्रवत तान् पार्थः किरशरशतान् बहून। हर्षयन् पाण्डवान् योधान् भीमसेनपुरोगमान्॥
en: The Pandava warriors, with Bhimasena at their head, were all very happy to see Partha follow the flying columns shooting inany hundreds of arrows.

sa: न तेऽस्रगोचरे शक्ताः स्थातुं देवाः सवासवाः। किमु पार्थाः सपाञ्चालाः सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Not to speak of the sons of Pritha together with the Panchalas, even the very celestials together with their allies cannot stand within the range of your weapon. I speak this truly.

sa: पञ्चालान् सोमकांश्चैव जहि द्रौणे सहानुगान्। वयं शेषान् हनिष्यामस्त्वयैव परिरक्षिताः॥
en: O Drona's son, destroy the Panchalas as well as the Somakas together with all their followers. Protected by you we shall slay the rest.

sa: धिगस्तु मम लुब्धस्य यत्कृते सर्ववान्धवाः। सुखार्हाः परमं दुःखं प्राप्नुवन्त्यपराजिताः॥
en: Fie on my avaricious self on whose account all the friends, solicitous of my welfare, are, being vanquished (in battle), now experiencing great misery.

sa: अहो द्यूतस्य निष्ठेयं घोरा सम्प्रति वर्तते। अहो तीव्राणि दुःखानि दुर्योधनकृतान्यहम्॥ सोढा घोराणि बहुशः शल्यभूतानि संजय।
en: Alas! the most dreadful result of gaming at dice has now been visible. O Sanjaya, I now hear of the greatest sorrows, that had been brought about by foolish, Duryodhana and also that resemble a large number of deadly arrows!

sa: इति ते तं नरव्याघ्र प्रशंसन्तो महारथाः। निद्रया समवाक्षिप्तास्तूष्णीमासन् विशाम्पते॥
en: Thus, O foremost of men, those mighty carwarriors, while praising Partha, thus were stupefied by sleep and soon became silent, O ruler of men.
